noise.description: Undulating, cavernous structures formed from coalesced cosmic dust and forgotten memory fragments, subtly shifting as if breathing within the vastness.

shader.description: A vast, nebulous void with deep indigo and purple hues, subtly shifting like cosmic dust. Faint, ethereal glows of silver and lavender pulse gently, representing coalesced memory fragments, hinting at something ancient and profound within the emptiness.

audio.ambience: A vast, almost suffocating silence, punctuated by very low-frequency hums and distant, resonant rumbles that hint at immense, unseen structures.
sfx: deep, resonant rumbles that fade quickly
barely audible, distorted echoes of forgotten sounds
audio.description: An expansive, deeply melancholic soundscape. The ambience is dominated by a vast, almost suffocating silence, punctuated by very low-frequency hums and distant, resonant rumbles. The music is slow and eerie, built upon deep atmospheric synthesizers and sub-bass drones, interwoven with mournful cello lines and the delicate, shimmering sounds of glass harmonica and ethereal chimes. Sparse, processed whispers and barely audible, distorted echoes of forgotten sounds occasionally break through the stillness, emphasizing the repository of untold stories within the void.
